author: Praxis IV
title: Unit Test v3.2 (Debug): ASN Step with Normalization
abstract: This is the third debug attempt for the ASN step computation (ID 585), which continued to produce an unstable step. The root cause has been identified as an unscaled Newton step magnitude. This version implements a robust fix by normalizing the computed step vector 'dx' to a fixed, small length (1e-4). This approach uses the powerful direction information from the second-order method while discarding its unstable magnitude, ensuring a controlled, stable update. The test aims to verify that this fix produces a step 'dx' with a predictable, small norm.
